basis: visual inspection of the boundary-review plots (waveform, frame RMS, spectrogram) by the analyst; no listening test, so these are observations, not ground truth

reviews.observation: Low-level (-35 to -22 dB) impulsive activity: isolated spikes mostly in the left channel and a vertical broadband line near 0.26 s in the spectrogram; no harmonic stripes. Voiced low-frequency energy only starts near 0.72 s.
reviews.judgement: Probably mouth/handling clicks or breath rather than speech, but not provable from the plots. Preserved (conservative).

reviews.observation: Frame RMS dips to the noise floor around 0.56-0.70 s and the vowel's harmonic band appears at about 0.72 s. This stretch is labelled speech only because it lies within the 150 ms onset extension.
reviews.judgement: Boundary is conservative (starts about 0.1 s before the visible onset). Acceptable.

reviews.region: end of file, trailing silence from about 2.10 s
reviews.observation: Vowel energy decays smoothly into a flat noise floor (about -42 dB) with no harmonic structure in the spectrogram.
reviews.judgement: Confident silence; trimmed with 100 ms padding.

reviews.observation: Broadband low-level noise about 8-12 dB above the floor with no harmonic structure; clear voiced onset (harmonics, rising RMS) at about 0.44 s.
reviews.judgement: Likely background noise or breath; ambiguous, preserved. The earlier baseline had cut this to start at 0.34 s.

reviews.observation: After the vowel of the last syllable decays (about 1.3 s) the frame RMS sits at the noise floor for about 0.18 s.
reviews.judgement: Confident internal silence but shorter than 400 ms and next to an ambiguous region, so it is preserved, not shortened.

reviews.region: 1.53-1.82 s (ambiguous, kept to end of file)
reviews.observation: Low-level activity (-35 to -25 dB), mostly energy below about 300 Hz, no word-like harmonic structure after the burst and vowel that end near 1.3 s.
reviews.judgement: Probably breath, handling or room noise, but unresolved. Preserved; it is the main remaining uncertainty.
